sources.title: vLLM inference and serving on ROCm — AMD ROCm AI Ecosystem
sources.snippet: vLLM inference and serving on ROCm # vLLM is an open-source library for fast, memory-efficient LLM inference and serving. This page describes how to set up and run vLLM on AMD GPUs and APUs using either a prebuilt Docker image (recommended) or pip. It applies to supported AMD GPUs and platforms.
